MATHEMATICS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #17
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 43

2. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 31

3. What is √16? (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 16
   C. 5
   D. 4

4. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x + 2
   B. 12x
   C. 6x
   D. 6x + 2

5. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.6
   B. 19.7
   C. 19
   D. 25

6. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 36
   C. 77
   D. 22

7. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 37
   D. 1

8. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 44
   B. 30
   C. 105
   D. 22

9. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. They are equal
   B. 1/4
   C. 1/2
   D. Cannot tell

10. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 25
   C. 1
   D. 2

11. What is √81? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 9
   C. 40.5
   D. 81

12. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27
   B. 27.7
   C. 33
   D. 27.6

13. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 0.025
   B. 0.25
   C. 0.205
   D. 2.5

14. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 100 000 m²
   B. 10 000 m²
   C. 100 m²
   D. 1000 m²

15. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 49

16. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 37
   C. 31.6
   D. 31.7

17. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 18 cm³
   B. 27 cm³
   C. 9 cm³
   D. 12 cm³

18. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 1/2
   B. 3/4
   C. 1/4
   D. 2/3

19. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x > 5
   B. x < 5
   C. x = 5
   D. x ≥ 0 only

20. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 15.7
   C. 15
   D. 15.6

21. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.7
   B. 29
   C. 23.6
   D. 23

22. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 38
   B. 19
   C. 30
   D. 60

23. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. Cannot tell
   B. 1/4
   C. They are equal
   D. 2/2

24. What is √36? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 36
   C. 6
   D. 7

25. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 15
   C. 44
   D. 30

26. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 26
   C. 10
   D. 25

27. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 144
   C. 48
   D. 156

28. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 6 cm and 8 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 14
   C. 2
   D. 10

29. Solve for x: x + 5 = 10. (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 5
   C. 6
   D. 5

30. In the number 3545, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 400
   C. 10
   D. 40

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

32. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

33. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

34. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

35. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

36. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

37. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

38. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

39. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

40. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
